Name: VTT Deck
Description: Control Foundry VTT (v13/v14) from your Stream Deck: macros, scenes, tokens, combat, music and more. Requires the free "VTT Deck" Foundry VTT module.

com.vttdeck.foundry.scene.Name: Scene
com.vttdeck.foundry.scene.Tooltip: View or activate a Foundry VTT scene

com.vttdeck.foundry.token.Name: Token
com.vttdeck.foundry.token.Tooltip: Show a token (image, HP) and act on it

com.vttdeck.foundry.combat.Name: Combat
com.vttdeck.foundry.combat.Tooltip: Control the combat tracker and show combatants

com.vttdeck.foundry.playlist.Name: Music & Sounds
com.vttdeck.foundry.playlist.Tooltip: Start or stop playlists, tracks and sound effects

com.vttdeck.foundry.system.Name: System
com.vttdeck.foundry.system.Tooltip: Pause, tools, sidebar, dice, roll tables, chat, darkness

com.vttdeck.foundry.numpad.Name: Damage & Healing Pad
com.vttdeck.foundry.numpad.Tooltip: Type an amount, then apply damage or healing to the selected tokens

com.vttdeck.foundry.ambiance.Name: Ambience
com.vttdeck.foundry.ambiance.Tooltip: Set scene, music, darkness and weather with one key

com.vttdeck.foundry.page.Name: Dynamic Page
com.vttdeck.foundry.page.Tooltip: Fill keys with the macros, scenes or music of a Foundry folder

com.vttdeck.foundry.sequence.Name: Sequence
com.vttdeck.foundry.sequence.Tooltip: Chain several Foundry VTT actions with one key, without code

com.vttdeck.foundry.dial.Name: Dial
com.vttdeck.foundry.dial.Tooltip: Dials for Foundry VTT: volumes, darkness, turns, token HP, zoom, party, scenes, targets, tracks, dice and macros (Stream Deck + and + XL)
